method: serialized fresh isolated compilation of every root production module
dependency_policy: pinned cached mathlib/dependency oleans; dependencies not rebuilt
production_discovery: every root *.lean file, plus generated AxiomAudit.lean
parallelism: one module subprocess at a time, one Lean worker

axiom_coverage.selection: all environment declarations by defining production module; no blacklist
axiom_coverage.source_scan_role: supplementary subset cross-check, not the audit selection mechanism

summary.selection: Environment.getModuleIdxFor? defining module; no name blacklist
